gemm_activation_quantization: FlashInfer FP4 quantization with swizzled block-scale layout
standalone_dequantization: diagnostic FlashInfer NVFP4 KV linear-layout kernel; not part of the FP4 GEMM hot path, whose output scaling is fused
pipeline_residual: FP4 end-to-end median minus separately timed GEMM-layout quantization and prequantized GEMM medians; cache handoff and independent sampling mean this value is diagnostic, not additive
p99_absolute_error: exact when the output has at most 1,000,000 values; otherwise computed from at most 1,000,000 deterministically strided samples
